diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: The IRGC Navy called US officials' statements about the Strait of Hormuz being open an 'obvious lie' and stated these remarks are made to control oil prices and cover up America's failures. The force declared that the fighters' dominance over this strategic waterway is completely decisive and the strait is closed to all vessels attempting passage without coordination with the Islamic Republic of Iran. This process will continue until the end of the US Army's mischief against the country and the fulfillment of stipulated obligations.

Tractor football team reached the top of the Premier League by defeating Chadormalu in the fourth week. Javad Nekounam's team exploited the spaces behind Chadormalu's defenders and pressured them. A technical analysis of the match was provided by Mohammad Taghavi.

Mohsen Rezaee referred to Mojtaba Khamenei's emphasis on avoiding discouraging speech and illusory dichotomies. He described this stance as a clear and unambiguous strategy. Mojtaba Khamenei also stated that any action harming social cohesion is forbidden.

Mohammad Mashinchian stated that out of 66 million Iranians of working age, only about 24 million are employed, and the official unemployment rate does not reflect the real labor market. He said this inaccurate data leads to policies that do not align with labor market realities. He also warned that job losses and economic pressures will expand the informal economy and worsen the livelihood crisis.

Israel Hayom reported that six months after the war began, US and Israeli attacks have severely damaged Iran's military capabilities but have not led to the government's overthrow. Iran has restored part of its missile capabilities and affected traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. The US is trying to isolate Iran through economic expulsion, but Washington's ultimate goal remains unclear.

Meysam Mehrani said the Islamic Republic still uses the Strait of Hormuz as leverage, but the US has increased the cost of using it. He added that the Strait of Hormuz is no longer a major advantage in negotiations. Regional countries seek to reduce tensions and restore stability.

Hossein Ghazian stated that the shortage of teachers in Iran has led to increased class sizes and a decline in education quality. Statistics indicate a significant shortage of human resources in the education system. He also pointed to the use of retired teachers and soldier-teachers as a result of misguided policies.

The Iran Human Rights Campaign announced that internal repression in Iran has significantly increased since the start of the war. The organization states that long prison and death sentences are issued in political trials without fair trials. Vague national security charges are increasingly used to criminalize dissent and issue death sentences.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, responded to Mojtaba Khamenei's emphasis on maintaining social cohesion by stating that his message is a guiding principle for all officials. Ghalibaf added that one must avoid illusory dichotomies and any action harming social cohesion is nationally and religiously forbidden. Mojtaba Khamenei had earlier stressed avoiding discouraging speech and illusory dichotomies.

Donald Trump announced that the US has reached a major oil agreement with Venezuela. According to the deal, the US will control the majority of over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil without cost to taxpayers. This agreement will more than double US oil reserves and help reduce gasoline prices.

The International Maritime Organization stated that the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz remains unresolved six months after the Iran war. About 400 ships carrying nearly six thousand sailors have not been able to safely pass through the area. The organization reported 70 incidents and 19 sailor deaths.

NBC News reported, citing two informed individuals, that US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has privately discussed the possibility of running in the 2028 presidential election. The Pentagon denied the report, calling it “ridiculous.”

Marco Rubio called the oil agreement between the US and Venezuela a major victory for both countries. The deal will bring nearly $100 billion in private investment to Venezuela and help rebuild its economy. Donald Trump described the agreement as the largest oil deal in world history.

The US Central Command announced that by August 28, it had redirected 82 commercial ships, disabled three ships, and boarded two ships. These actions were part of the naval blockade against Iran. CENTCOM also released an image of a sailor on the USS John Paul Jones destroyer.

The New York Times reported in an analysis that six months after the start of the war with the Iranian government, most of President Donald Trump's goals have not been achieved, and the conflict continues without an exit strategy or a clear end. According to the newspaper, the Islamic Republic's air and naval capabilities have been damaged, but Tehran still has the ability to attack US bases and its allies. The newspaper added that daily ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has decreased from about 130 vessels before the war to 12.

The Associated Press reported that six months after the start of the war with Iran, American diplomats and some of their family members who had left regional countries in the early days of the war are returning to US embassies in the Middle East. The US State Department has begun easing some restrictions, and its embassies in Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain have authorized the return of diplomats' family members. These restrictions were imposed in March following attacks by the Islamic Republic on American interests, embassies, and military installations.

Iranian officials acknowledge increased economic pressure amid six months of conflict with the US. The Iranian president reported a 35% decrease in exports and imports and 66% inflation. Meanwhile, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz continue with reduced ship traffic.

Political analyst Najat Bahrami, referring to Masoud Pezeshkian's description of the economic situation, said the Islamic Republic has 'run out of steam' in the economic sphere. He warned that continued US economic pressure and siege could push the regime toward creating tension or conflict in the region. Bahrami added that if the Trump administration continues this pressure until the November elections, the Islamic Republic might resort to a tension-creating action to disrupt this process.

Mohammad Qaedi discussed the oil contract between the US and Venezuela, stating that US investment could increase Venezuela's oil production capacity. He pointed out ambiguity regarding the interim government's authority to sign a long-term contract. The possibility of the contract being challenged in the future is also a major obstacle.

Houshang Hassan Yari stated that Hezbollah has lost a significant part of its military capabilities and commanders. Naeem Qassem expressed support for the Islamic Republic, but Hezbollah currently lacks effective military support capacity. These statements are mainly a political message to maintain groups aligned with the Islamic Republic.

Ardavan Rouzbeh from Iran International said the US-Venezuela oil agreement affects the Strait of Hormuz crisis and US bargaining power against the Islamic Republic more than the oil volume. He added the agreement could strengthen Washington's position in negotiations or war and reduce Tehran's demands.

Mojtaba Khamenei emphasized in a written message the prohibition of anything that harms social cohesion. This message goes beyond a usual statement and focuses on controlling the narrative of problems and avoiding dichotomies. Social cohesion has also become related to national security and a religious ruling.

The Tehran prosecutor announced that the indictment for the case of the killing of Ali Khamenei and four members of his family has been sent to court for trial. All perpetrators are under judicial pursuit, with charges including participation in spreading corruption on earth through terrorist acts. In the attack on Esfand 9, Ali Khamenei and four family members were killed.

Mohammad Oliaifard referred to a report by the Iran Human Rights Campaign stating that internal repression has intensified since the start of the war, driven by a logic of survival rather than governance. He added that the Islamic Republic uses wartime conditions to increase repression. These actions stem from the regime's fear of future protests.
After the death of Harald V, his 53-year-old son Haakon ascended the throne as the new king of Norway. He chose the name Haakon VIII for his reign. This news was reported by Mehran Abbassian.

Majid Adineh, a retired military officer, participated in protests on the evening of January 9. The Revolutionary Court of Karaj sentenced him to death and confiscation of property on charges including waging war and acting in favor of Israel and the United States. His death sentence was confirmed by the Supreme Court.

Ahmad Alavi referred to Masoud Pezeshkian's statements, saying the government is indecisive about raising the price of the third gasoline quota. He added that this uncertainty increases economic insecurity. Alavi also warned that the price increase could intensify dissatisfaction and lead to social unrest.

Ruhollah Rahimpour referred to Mojtaba Khamenei's message about the need to maintain social cohesion and said these emphases indicate a lack of cohesion and plurality in the power structure. He added that Masoud Pezeshkian's remarks about economic problems show discord at the top of power. Rahimpour identified the government of Pezeshkian as the message's audience and spoke of the formation of a "Mojtaba dictatorship."

Ruhollah Rahimpour referred to Mojtaba Khamenei's message about the need to maintain social cohesion and said repeated emphasis by officials on unity indicates its absence. He added that Masoud Pezeshkian's statements about economic problems show discord at the top of power. Rahimpour also said the main audience of Mojtaba Khamenei's message is Pezeshkian's government, and limiting the expression of problems signals the formation of a dictatorship.

Burial costs and the buying and selling of burial rights in Iran have reached billion-toman prices. This has become part of the livelihood crisis for families. Saman Rahmatian examined the impact of the economic crisis on the cemetery market in a report.

A video shows that on the 7th of Shahrivar, images of Yasmin and Noor Pahlavi were pasted on a wall in a neighborhood in Tehran. These images are of the wife and daughter of Prince Reza Pahlavi. This event was recorded by a citizen.

Hojat Karimi, CEO of Tractor club, denied negotiations with Mehdi Taremi and said they will negotiate with him next year. He also stated that they have not negotiated with Sardar Azmoun but would like him to join Tractor. He hopes this will happen.

Cristiano Ronaldo scored against Al Taawoun to reach 104 goals for Al Nassr in the Saudi Pro League, surpassing Mohammad Al-Sahlawi's 103 goals and becoming the club's all-time top scorer in the competition.

Maryam Tajangi, a resident of Golbahar, has been held in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad for nearly two months. Her case is under investigation in one of the interrogation branches in Golbahar. Her interrogation session was held via videoconference.

The birthday ceremony of Seyed Aref Mirmousavi was held at his tomb with the presence of his family. Security forces blocked the area around the mosque and tomb, preventing some attendees from entering. Aref Mirmousavi was injured during the Tehran protests and died from his wounds.

Ahmad Meydari, Minister of Cooperatives, Labor, and Social Welfare, stated that the Islamic Republic is engaged in an economic war alongside the military war, and the government aims to win this war. He said the US is not adhering to agreements it previously accepted and is violating its commitments. Meydari described the US as untrustworthy and emphasized that the enemy failed to defeat Iran in the military war.

The football teams Persepolis and Malavan will face each other on Saturday, 7th of Shahrivar 1405, at Ghal'eh Hasan Khan Stadium. This match is part of the fourth week of the Premier League. Iran International Sports Instagram page has a poll about the match result.
A man in Mashhad killed his wife and two young sons using a cold weapon. After this incident, he ended his own life.

Ali Hashemi, a detained protester from the December protests, died of cardiac arrest in Al-Zahra Hospital in Isfahan. He was arrested on May 15 at his father's home and was held in Isfahan Central Prison. His family initially expected his release upon paying a fine but were later told to await a court hearing.

Iran International audiences reacted to Mokhberian's remarks about the naturalness of price increases. They believe the next round of widespread protests will also be natural. Mohsen Mahimini has explained these reactions.

Alireza Mansourian stated that he resolved the issue of signing the hosting letter for Esteghlal in the Asian Elite League by using his connections with the Iraqi Football Federation officials. This was mentioned in an interview with Mazdak Mirzaei. The Hattrick program has published this interview.

The Islamic Republic's cabinet responded to Mojtaba Khamenei's message by stating it will stand against US and Israeli sanctions and conspiracies, advancing diplomacy and defense simultaneously. Controlling inflation, market management, job creation, and supporting domestic production are priorities of the fourteenth government. Gradual reduction of dependence on the dollar is also planned.

Naim Qassem, Secretary-General of Hezbollah Lebanon, rejected the agreement between Lebanon and Israel mediated by the US. He described the agreement as illegal, humiliating, and destructive for the Lebanese government. Qassem stated that Hezbollah will continue its presence in southern Lebanon.

Experimental cultivation of Elifra poppy on nearly 10 hectares of government land has been successful. This plant has suitable potential for supplying pharmaceutical raw materials and producing morphine. Cultivation of this plant will only be allowed on government lands.

A video shows the moment of ground subsidence in Nashat Street, Isfahan. The head of crisis management in Isfahan province stated that the cause was a sewage pipeline break. This incident occurred at noon on the 7th of Shahrivar.
Some Iranian businesses in Dubai have been closed. National and Saderat banks remain active in the UAE. Bank Misr continues its operations despite losing access to the US financial system.

Hojat Karimi, CEO of Tractor, stated that there is a legal deadline until the end of October for Alireza Beiranvand's military service, and Beiranvand has not yet terminated his contract with the club. He emphasized that the club is following up on the player's situation and that these news reports appeared at a sensitive time before the match with Persepolis. Karimi also mentioned the military exemptions of other league players.

Political prisoners and families in Iran issued a statement expressing support for Reza Pahlavi and his team. They emphasized their main goal is to end the Islamic Republic's rule and build a free and democratic future. They also warned against defamation and baseless rumors against members of Reza Pahlavi's team.

Babak Khatti, a pediatrician, warned about adding half a percent of methanol to gasoline. He said methanol can damage the optic nerve and liver and in severe cases cause permanent blindness. Direct exposure to methanol vapors causes eye problems, dizziness, and respiratory issues.

Today, Saturday, 7 Shahrivar, some environmental health personnel in Hamedan protested against their living conditions and demands. The protesters demanded the removal of discrimination regarding Thursday remote work and payment of overdue wages. They also requested special bonuses, incentives, clothing allowance, and transportation costs.

The head of Imam Khomeini Hospital Complex in Tehran reported a lack of empty beds and an occupancy rate of up to 200% in the emergency department. He cited high private sector tariffs, economic problems, and patient referrals from other cities as reasons for increased visits to public hospitals. He also warned that this situation causes treatment delays and staff burnout in the emergency department.

According to the US Treasury report, a branch of Bank of Egypt in the UAE conducted dollar operations for the Islamic Republic. This bank was part of Iran's shadow banking system. After the sanctions, the bank announced it would cooperate with the US government.

Three days after a deadly flood in the border areas of Nepal and Tibet, the death toll has exceeded 600. About three thousand people remain missing. This information was announced by Nepalese authorities.

Yadollah Javani, the political deputy of the IRGC, stated that unlike the Islamic Republic, the US has no military cards to play. He also commented on the claim that stopping enrichment would have prevented war, saying those who make this claim lack accurate historical information or proper analysis.

One of the commercial units of the Badameshk complex in Birjand was sealed by judicial order. The reason for sealing this unit has not been announced yet. It is likely that this action is part of enforcing Islamic norms and recent crackdowns on businesses.

Mehdi Rahmati, head coach of Gol Gohar, said in a press conference after the match with Sepahan that Iranian football has a general problem, which is the football federation. He added that decisions are made in the federation that do not exist anywhere else in the world. He also mentioned that if he talks about the events in the federation, he would have to answer in many places and face controversies.

The tuition fees at Azad University have increased by 65 to 70 percent compared to last year. Inflation is severe, making it difficult to afford basic needs such as medicine and food. Additionally, issues like power outages and weak internet have been reported.

Iranians held a gathering in Stockholm protesting executions and repression. Participants commemorated Cyrus the Great and emphasized unity among Iranians and support for Prince Reza Pahlavi. The message of the gathering was united resistance for achieving a free and dignified Iran.

Ebrahim Azizi, head of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, said Trump admitted facing a difficult task in Iran focused on the Strait of Hormuz. Azizi added that the enemy has not succeeded in reopening the Strait of Hormuz so far. He also emphasized that Iranian forces conduct powerful operations nightly in the Strait, and no American vessels are seen in the area.

The death toll from floods in Nepal and Tibet has reached 633. Two thousand nine hundred eighty people are still missing, and over 460 have been injured. Rain and fog have disrupted search operations.

Rouhollah Lak Aliabadi, deputy head of the parliamentary health commission, called seizing American resources a practical way to counter sanctions. He urged hitting the economic or military interests of the US if necessary. He emphasized that wherever they have access to US interests, those resources should be seized.
Roya (Razieh) Hashemi, a citizen from Abdanan, was detained by security forces three days ago. Her place of detention remains unknown. The arrest was made without presenting a judicial warrant.

The Iranian women's team became the runner-up in the World Backgammon Championship in London. The final match between Iran and the USA was held on 5 Shahrivar 1405. The members of the Iranian women's backgammon team were introduced.
A ranger in Baft County was injured during a mission by two illegal hunters. The offenders were identified and arrested.

Masoumeh Taherkhani, an economic analyst, criticized the performance of the Pezeshkian government in managing the currency crisis. She said the government only reports the poor economic situation instead of providing an operational plan. She also warned that the president's remarks about reducing currency demand could lead to more rationing and increased inflation.

According to reports, the Islamic Republic has provided weapons training to its supporters. A citizen reported weapons training for women and children in Kashan. Asieh Amini considers this action an ideological, security, and economic abuse.

Masoud Pezeshkian, head of the Islamic Republic government, stated that implementing the agreement with the US based on internal unity can help overcome problems. He emphasized that the agreement is approved by all concerned patriots. Pezeshkian believes that executing it can help overcome difficulties.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International criticizing the price increases. He said that buying two bags of food items using ration cards cost about four million tomans. This indicates a significant rise in living expenses.

Hamidreza Davoodvandi stated at a gathering in Qom that immodesty and lack of chastity threaten society in the end times. He added that the spread of immorality reduces the faith of young people and weakens their resistance against the enemy. Davoodvandi called on officials to pay attention to the issue of hijab and chastity.

Power outage occurred at Azadi Sports Hall in Khorasgan, Isfahan on Saturday, 7th of Shahrivar. This incident caused a delay of about two hours in the taekwondo competitions. Athletes, coaches, and referees were present at the event.

Reports indicate that military training courses are being held for employees and supporters of the Islamic Republic in Tehran. The Tehran municipality has started weapons training for staff in its 22 districts. These courses are held amid increased security measures and concerns about potential protests.
Yesterday, three women named Shima, Saimeh, and Setayesh Bamari were arrested by security forces in Iranshahr. The arrest involved violence and beating. Their place of detention is unknown.

The US Open tennis tournament will start on Sunday, 30 August. Tennis fans in New York welcomed the event with a 'Fan Week' celebration. The presence of big stars and diverse programs has energized the atmosphere of the tournament.
Supporters of the government in Qom protested against optional dress codes. They formed a human chain in Alavi Park. Participants emphasized support for hijab and chastity.

The Rajaei port in Bandar Abbas, Iran's largest commercial port, has recently been seen without ships and normal commercial activity. Masoud Pezeshkian stated that the goods entry route is closed and gasoline is not being imported. This indicates a halt in import activities at this port.
A citizen criticized the high prices and said that due to economic pressure, nothing remains in his refrigerator except bread and dates.

Persepolis fans at the entrance of Ghal'eh Hasan Khan stadium asked Mehdi Tartaar to play Oston Aronov. Aronov is also on the bench for the match against Malavan and is not in the starting lineup. These protests are due to Aronov's benching in recent weeks.

Five citizens from Sardush village in Mariwan, including Azad Norouzi, Zanyar Tavana, Pouya KakaMohammadi, Zanyar Ghaderi, and Shirzad Abdi, were arrested by security forces. They have been transferred to an unknown location. This event occurred today.

Pezeshkian stated that with the continuation of sanctions, prices will increase. The former head of Mossad said that to overthrow the Iranian regime, economic pressure must be combined with military attacks and popular protests. These statements came after a message attributed to Mojtaba Khamenei about censoring shortages was published.

Mohammad Estavarmimandi stated that the enemies of Islam and the Islamic Republic threaten to assassinate the new leader. He said those involved in the assassination of the martyr Imam are subject to the death penalty. Estavarmimandi considered the death penalty obligatory for all perpetrators of this operation, from Trump and Netanyahu to other involved parties.

Najmeh Sadat Bonyan, a female diver residing in Dezful, was arrested by security forces and transferred to Sepidar Prison in Ahvaz. She is accused of insulting religious sanctities. She had previously participated in the protests of Dey 1404.

The birthday ceremony of Amir Mahdi Keshavarz, a 17-year-old footballer killed in Qazvin, was held at his grave with his family's presence. Police forces were stationed around the grave and only the family was allowed to attend. Amir Mahdi Keshavarz was killed during protests in Zibashahr, Qazvin.
Masoud Pezeshkian stated that if electricity must be cut, government electricity should be cut, not the production sector. He advised governors to prepare for winter and fuel management.

The Iranian under-17 volleyball team defeated France 3-1 in the final of the World Championship in Doha, Qatar. Iran lost the third set but won the first, second, and fourth sets. This is Iran's first championship in this tournament.

Since the beginning of 2026, the Abdul Rahman Boroumand Foundation has documented 950 executions in Iran. Among those executed are at least 20 women and 30 protesters. Additionally, 45 executions were recorded in August.
Government sources announced that popular forces have been deployed to the Strait of Hormuz. This action was taken in response to Trump's provocations. Further details have not been disclosed.

According to recorded rates on Saturday, 6 Shahrivar 1405, the US dollar price in the free market was about 205,880 tomans, and in the Herat market about 205,230 tomans. The euro was traded at about 238,910 tomans, the pound at about 279,090 tomans, and the Canadian dollar at about 148,650 tomans. Each gram of 18-karat gold was reported at about 21,810,790 tomans, and each misqal of melted gold at about 94,480,000 tomans.

Steven Miller, Deputy Chief of Staff at the White House, said Trump has achieved the most in fighting the Islamic terrorism of the Iranian government. He claimed that Iran's navy, air force, radars, and military command structure have been destroyed. Miller described this situation as the most asymmetric military achievement in modern war history.

Ali Kalateh Dolati, detained in connection with the December 2025 protests, has been held in Sabzevar prison for over 45 days without a judicial decision. His family has seen no progress in his case despite repeated follow-ups. He is also deprived of contact and visits with his family.

A video sent to Iran International shows the slogan "Long live the Shah" on a wall in Mehrshahr, Karaj. The video is from a specific location in Karaj. The slogan in this video has attracted attention.

UEFA has opened a disciplinary case against Red Star Belgrade for displaying banners honoring Ratko Mladić during a match against Viktoria Plzeň. Mladić, convicted of the Srebrenica genocide, died on Thursday. Fans held banners reading "General, eternal glory and thanks" and chanted his name during the game.

The absence of Mojtaba Khamenei continues while power gaps in the Islamic Republic have increased. Jaber Rajabi says security reasons do not sufficiently explain this absence. His absence, given his limited position, has deepened the existing void.

The Minister of Science said that during crises people become more united, but after the crisis, demands increase. He emphasized the need for social capital and development of welfare for societal resilience. He also stated that the perception of a large gap with major powers is incorrect and Iran has the ability to stand firm.

Persepolis football team defeated Malavan 3-0 in the fourth week of the Premier League. The goals were scored by Mohammad Papi (own goal), Tivi Bifuma, and Ali Alipour. Persepolis reached third place in the standings with 9 points.

Shin Bet announced that Yair Netanyahu was returned from Florida to Israel after receiving a death threat. There was a significant threat against him, and a rescue operation was carried out with the security team's cooperation. Shin Bet forces were dispatched to Miami for this operation.

Hundreds of people in Norway gathered in Oslo to pay respects during the transfer of King Harald V's coffin to the royal palace. Harald, aged 89, died after being hospitalized due to a blood infection. His son Haakon succeeded him.
Niusha Saremi discussed the dispute over Mojtaba Khamenei's new message in Titraavol. Qalibaf warned about internal disagreements. This topic was raised in the audio version of the Titraavol program.

On Saturday, 7 Shahrivar, environmental health personnel in Hamedan held a protest over unmet demands. Additionally, oil and gas workers at the Day gas field in Farashband held a protest on Thursday. These protests were held to express their grievances.

The US State Department spokesperson stated that the US stands with the people of Lebanon and calls for Hezbollah's disarmament for Lebanon's security and independence. He added that Hezbollah has so far refused to engage in talks with the Lebanese government, the US, or Israel. He also emphasized that it is time for Hezbollah to take actions that benefit Lebanon.

Abbas Rasouli-Far, a commander with experience in Syria, led the suppression forces in Shahriar during the national revolution in December 2025. A political analyst stated that the Iranian regime's response to protests has gone beyond classic suppression methods and resembles urban military operations. This pattern was previously used in the Syrian war.

The Minister of Science stated that more than 400 expelled students and 100 professors have been reinstated at universities. He described the dismissal process as "cunning" and said these individuals were removed in a way that did not officially count as expulsion. The time frame of these expulsions was not specified.

Alireza Elhami, commander of the joint air defense headquarters, stated that air defense is the top priority for the country's defense. He added that in the recent war, air defense personnel were at the forefront of countering threats. He also mentioned that Ali Khamenei issued the order to establish this headquarters in 2009.

Kazem Gharibabadi stated that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed and any ship passage requires coordination and permission from the Islamic Republic. Iran is in no hurry to reopen the strait and the armed forces have full oversight of movements there. The understanding between Iran and Oman on transit arrangements will not be implemented until the United States fulfills its commitments.

Duolingo announced that the institution's language test is unavailable in Iran and for holders of Iranian identity documents. At the same time, reports have been published about TOEFL test cancellations and the absence of new dates for holding it in Iran. These developments come days after OFAC suspended General License G.

Ahmad Alavi said Masoud Pezeshkian's remarks about the rising exchange rate indicate the government's attempt to evade responsibility. He added that the government has no solution to control the currency market and blames external factors. He also warned that if there are problems paying employees' salaries, the economic crisis could turn into a political crisis.

Karim Bagheri stated in a press conference after the match with Malavan that fans should be patient and only support the Persepolis team. He emphasized that it does not matter who plays, as all players serve the team.

Gholamreza Nouri Ghezeljeh stated that there is no problem in supplying goods, but siege, war, and sanctions affect prices. The government is trying to reduce the burden of these costs on people. Global prices of essential goods and transportation costs have increased.

A Russian airstrike on an ammunition depot in Bucha resulted in at least 37 deaths. Volodymyr Zelensky criticized the storage of weapons near residential areas. A criminal investigation into possible negligence in ammunition storage has been initiated.

Abbas Mousavi stated that national power must be increased to guarantee the implementation of the agreement. He assessed the likelihood of implementing the agreement with the US through guarantees from China, Russia, or the Security Council as very low. Mousavi added that international law is now nothing more than a scrap of paper.
